title: Apex Prompt OS — Prompt Record front-matter
description: Contract schema (L1) for the YAML front-matter of a .prompt.md record. The router's parser ignores this front-matter entirely (it reads only '## heading' + ```text fences), so this block is additive and non-breaking. Body typed-section rules and anti-pattern rules are enforced by the linter, not by this JSON Schema.

id.description: Immutable kebab-case identity. MUST equal slugify(heading) AND the file basename (without .prompt.md). Enforced by the linter (rules R2/R3) because the router keys routing and findPrompt on the slug derived from the heading.

version.description: Per-prompt semver. Breaking section/output-contract change = major; new edge handling = minor; copy fix = patch.

domain.description: Modular tree placement, replaces the flat monolith.

owner.description: Accountable human/agent who answers when this prompt regresses in production.

model_targets.description: Pinned model IDs the prompt is calibrated and eval'd against. A model bump flags the record for re-eval (drift trigger).

status.description: Lifecycle gate. Only 'published' records are eligible for the production label. 'published' requires >=1 eval_refs (linter R8). 'deprecated' requires a 'deprecated' date (linter R9).

contract_version.description: Which L1 contract schema version this record satisfies; lets the contract evolve without silently invalidating old records.

eval_refs.description: Paths to golden/<slug>.jsonl + adversarial suites that gate this record. Empty is allowed only for draft/in_review; 'published' requires >=1 (linter R8).

includes.description: Composition DSL — declarative assembly the router resolves at compose time instead of copy-paste. Phase 0 known blocks: universal-intake-contract, loops/loop-contract, loops/plan-implement-verify, loops/planner-generator-evaluator, loops/reflexion, loops/ralph-pattern (unknown values WARN, not error, until those blocks exist).

created.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the record was created.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last substantive change.

deprecated.description: ISO date the record was deprecated. Required iff status == 'deprecated' (linter R9); forbidden otherwise.
